stories.headline: Major administrative reshuffle : 136 JKAS officers transferred
stories.title: Major administrative reshuffle : 136 JKAS officers transferred
stories.summary: Srinagar, Sep 01: The Jammu and Kashmir Government on Tuesday ordered a major administrative reshuffle, transferring and posting 136 officers of the Jammu and Kashmir Administrative Service (JKAS) across various departments, institutions and districts. The transfers were ordered with immediate effect by the General Administration Department (GAD) through Government Order No. 1463-JK(GAD) of 2026, dated September 1. The government has directed that all the officers covered by the order shall be deemed to have been relieved immediately from their respective places of posting. Among the significant changes, Shahbaz Ahmad Mirza, JKAS, Member, J&K Special Tribunal, has been transferred and posted as Secretary, J&K Public Service Commission, against an available vacancy. Khalid Majeed, JKAS, awaiting orders of adjustment in the General Administration Department, has been posted as Special Secretary to the Government, School Education Department, while Kanta Devi, JKAS, Regional Director, Survey and Land Records (ex-officio Settlement Officer), Jammu, has been posted as Special Secretary to the Government, Health and Medical Education Department. Rajinder Singh, JKAS, Special Secretary to the Government, Agriculture Production Department, has been posted as Special Secretary to the Government, Department of Disaster Management, Relief, Rehabilitation and Reconstruction, while Sanjay Gupta, JKAS, Additional Secretary to the Government, Mining Department, has been posted as Additional Secretary to the Government, Department of Forest, Ecology and Environment. Amarjeet Singh, JKAS, Special Secretary to the Government, Hospitality and Protocol Department, has been posted as Additional District Development Commissioner, Poonch, while Pankaj Gupta, JKAS, Additional Inspector General of Registration, Jammu, has been posted as Regional Director, Survey and Land Records (ex-officio Settlement Officer), Doda. Gulzar Ahmad Bhat, JKAS, Administrator, Associated Hospitals, Srinagar, has been transferred and posted as Additional District Development Commissioner, Pulwama. Namrita Dogra, JKAS, Additional Commissioner, State Taxes (Administration and Enforcement), Jammu, has been posted as Regional Director, Survey and Land Records (ex-officio Settlement Officer), Jammu. Anju Gupta, JKAS, Additional Transport Commissioner, J&K, has been posted as Additional Inspector General of Registration, Jammu, while Ghulam Rasool, JKAS, Special Secretary to the Government, Revenue Department, has been posted as Additional District Development Commissioner, Kupwara. Jogindera Singh Rai, JKAS, Special Secretary to the Government, General Administration Department, has been posted as Managing Director, J&K Agro Industries Development Corporation, while Rifat Aftab Qureshi, JKAS, Additional District Development Commissioner, Srinagar, has been posted as Director, Command Area Development, Kashmir. Rajneesh Gupta, JKAS, Chief Operating Officer, Himayat, has been posted as Special Secretary to the Government, Hospitality and Protocol Department, while Dr Fayaz Ahmad Banday, JKAS, Director, Command Area Development, Kashmir, has been posted as Director, Urban Local Bodies, Kashmir. Basharat Hussain, JKAS, Chief Executive Officer/Secretary, J&K Khadi and Village Industries Board, has been posted as Chief Executive Officer, Tourism Development Authority, Rajouri. sentences.text: Srinagar, Sep 01: The Jammu and Kashmir Government on Tuesday ordered a major administrative reshuffle, transferring and posting 136 officers of the Jammu and Kashmir Administrative Service (JKAS) across various departments, institutions and districts.
The transfers were ordered with immediate effect by the General Administration Department (GAD) through Government Order No. 1463-JK(GAD) of 2026, dated September 1.

Nasir Mahmood Khan, JKAS, Joint Director (Administration), Directorate of Rural Development, Kashmir, has been posted as Deputy Commissioner, State Taxes, Enforcement (South), Kashmir, headquartered at Lower Munda.
